title: Adorable Animals Coloring Fun for Kids Ages 6-12
subtitle: Bold & Easy Cute Animal Designs for Creative Kids
description: Bring adorable animals to life with this fun coloring book designed just for kids ages 6-12! Featuring 3 bold, easy-to-color pages with cute friendly animals that kids will love. Each page has thick clean outlines perfect for crayons, markers, or colored pencils. Hours of creative fun await!
cover_prompt: A vibrant, full-color children's book cover illustration featuring a group of adorable cartoon animals together: a smiling puppy, a happy kitten, and a cheerful bunny, all with big expressive eyes and friendly faces. Bright colorful background with soft pastel tones, stars, and small hearts scattered around. Professional children's book cover art style, eye-catching and cheerful composition. DO NOT include any text, letters, or words in the image. Coloring Book for Kids Ages 6-12.
page_prompts: A children's coloring book page in PORTRAIT orientation. Black and white line art only. A cute happy puppy sitting with its tongue out, wearing a small bandana around its neck. The puppy has big round eyes and floppy ears. A few small paw prints scattered near its feet. Thick, clean, bold outlines. Simple enough for kids ages 6-12 to color. White background. The drawing fills most of the page vertically. No shading, no gray tones, no borders or frames. Style: cute, friendly, appealing to children.
